name: Spriglet: Desktop Companion
subtitle: A little quiet company
description:
Meet Mallow, a soft lavender companion for your Mac. It rests beneath the notch with its face visible, blinking and breathing while you work.

INTERACT DIRECTLY
Hover to get a reaction. Click to invite. Drag to play. Click elsewhere to return home. A second touch gets a wave or a gentle swing. Release near its home to catch it, or farther away for gravity and a squishy landing.

QUIET BY DEFAULT
Mallow returns to its small peek after you move on. Transparent margins pass clicks through. Displays without a notch use an upper-right resting place. Reduce Motion limits decorative movement; Low Power Mode, display sleep and session changes are respected.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, analytics or server connection. No screen capture or global keyboard monitoring. Plugins and assistant services are not active in this preview.

Requires an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or later.
promotionalText: Meet Mallow: a soft, living companion beneath your notch. Hover, touch, drag and let it settle. Native, quiet and local.
reviewNotes:
This is the Mallow rewrite preview. It has no account, backend, payments or active plugins. It appears directly in a transparent, nonactivating floating panel. It has no Dock icon, permanent menu-bar item, settings window or action cards.

Hover to get a reaction. Click to invite. Drag to play. Click elsewhere to return home. Touch again to react; drag to play. Release near its home to catch; click elsewhere to return. A display without a notch uses an upper-right home below the menu bar.

Right-click Mallow to return it home and choose Quit Spriglet from its small menu. Reopening from Finder returns it home without requesting keyboard focus. The app observes outside mouse clicks only to dismiss the character and reads no clicked content. It does not monitor global keyboard input. Reduce Motion limits decorative movement and animation suspends during system or display sleep, screen lock or an inactive session.

Launch at login is off for a new installation. Choose Launch at Login in Mallow’s right-click menu to explicitly register or unregister the main app with macOS. The menu reads the actual registration state and shows approval requirements, unavailable states and failed changes. If approval is required, choose Open Login Items Settings… and allow Spriglet in System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions; it will not launch at login until macOS reports it as enabled. Startup does not register automatically, and no helper app or separate saved login preference is used. Disabling login launch leaves the current companion running; quitting preserves the chosen registration.

This metadata is for local preparation; this rewrite has not been submitted to Apple.
